title: GitHub automation & AI repo management
description:
Using github and copilot AI to manage, automate and publish your repository. We will show a demo where we create a Github repository with:

- automated test of the code
- automated workflow for publishing as a webpage
- version upgrade for packages
- container publication
- secret variables.

All this also through the help of Github copilot, which can create automations in the repositories very effectively. Finally, we will show how to manage version control in a project on genomeDK computing cluster.

Cake and drinks provided! Share the invitation with your colleagues - please sign up only if you intend to actually participate 😊
